plan.title: AI Undo Changes Reverts Technical Questions

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation screen that contains a Technical Stage.
Provide the required event title for the create flow.
Configure the event with a Technical Stage so its questions and AI chat are available.
Move to the Technical Stage before configuring and testing its questions.
Apply a technical-stage template so the question section is populated.

args.goal: On the Technical Stage question builder, record the affected section's questions, use the AI chat panel to apply a change through a prompt, click Undo Changes, and verify that the affected section's questions return to exactly the state recorded before the prompt

steps.note: Perform and directly verify the AI edit and its undo behavior on screen.
Assert that the run remains on the configured Technical Stage after the undo verification.
